title: Recent advances in stable halide perovskite nanocrystals for optoelectronic devices, biological imaging, and X-ray detection
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00230C, Review Article
Rongze Zhu, Xinyu Ge, Geyu Feng, Aifei Wang, Xiao-Chun Hang, Longfei Ruan, Zhengtao Deng, Wei Huang
This review outlines halide perovskite nanocrystal stabilization strategies via ion-doping, heterostructures, core/shell and surface modification, applications in optoelectronics, biology, and X-ray detection, and discusses challenges and prospects.
